messages:
tara: Quick heads-up: saw parity oddness between Node SDK and REST in the starter-kit. Streaming chat never emits events from SDK, but curl SSE works.

ben: which SDK version + model?

tara: node-sdk v1.4.0, model rwd-2-medium. Starter-kit uses client.streamChat(req) and just...nothing. Curl -> /v1/chat/stream returns SSE chunks.

rui: can you paste the node snippet you called?

tara: sure:
```js
const req = { model: 'rwd-2-medium', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'hello'}] }
const stream = client.streamChat(req)
stream.on('data', (chunk) => console.log(chunk))
```
No data events.

ben: reproduce curl?

tara: this works:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream
```
Gives continuous SSE frames.

rui: quick check: do the raw requests from the SDK include Accept header? sometimes middlewares overwrite.

tara: grabbed tcpdump. Node SDK request headers: `Authorization: Bearer ...`, `Accept: */*`, `Content-Type: application/json`.

ben: aha. Server picks SSE only when Accept includes text/event-stream. `*/*` falls back to buffered json stream. Need special-case stream APIs in SDK.

rui: there's another wrinkle: starter-kit uses `response_length` in config (int) which REST accepts as number, but SDK serializes it as `null` when undefined pointer used. Server then treats it like zero-length response and closes stream early. Different param names across SDK and quickstarts introduced this.

tara: i saw that too — curl payload had `response_length: 256`, SDK payload ended up with `response_length: null` in a few cases.

ben: can we confirm serialization root cause? maybe our JSON encoder treats undefined numeric fields as `null` instead of omitting. That's a VERY old mismatch.

rui: i traced encoder.js: we coerce `undefined` -> null before stringify in some wrapper for telemetry; bug introduced in v1.3.8.

ben: plan:
- Quick patch: node-sdk special-case stream endpoints to set `Accept: text/event-stream`
- Fix encoder to omit undefined numeric fields (and add unit tests comparing sdk -> rest fixtures)
- Add an e2e test in CI: starter-kit run comparing curl vs sdk for stream endpoints.

cli-bot: Created issues: DEVX-701 (node-sdk stream Accept header), DEVX-702 (node-sdk undefined numeric -> null), DEVX-703 (ci starter-kit curl-vs-sdk stream test).

tara: i'll open a starter-kit PR marking the flaky test until fixes land.

ben: small note on retries: REST client library adds exponential backoff with jitter for 502s; node-sdk retries are immediate (legacy behavior). For streaming, immediate retry can hammer proxies and cause connection resets. we should align behaviors.

rui: agreed. add a toggle in SDK config to opt into server-style backoff until we flip default.

ben: i'll pick up the Accept header change + unit; rui take encoder fix; i'll draft a compatibility e2e job that runs in a lightweight CI pool.

tara: thanks. also let's add a snippet to the starter-kit README: how to verify streaming works with curl and how to dump raw headers (tcpdump example). New users keep getting blocked here.

cli-bot: Linked PRs: #182 (starter-kit: mark streaming flaky), #183 (node-sdk: stream accept header fix).

ben: timeline?

rui: encoder fix by EOD, unit tests added. ben you can land header fix after review. CI job next week.

tara: great. if anyone else hits streaming surprises, paste raw headers & the exact payload. makes root-cause much faster.
